title: lobivia maximiliana subsp. westii
intro: Lobivia maximiliana subsp. westii, commonly known as West's Lobivia, is a type of cactus plant that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of West's Lobivia include stimulating the respiratory system and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, which can aid in the relief of pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
